search_window.basis: Latest verified predecessor Gaza heartbeat completed at 23:58:47 PST on 8 Nov; authenticated GitHub compare showed four intervening commits to other watch ledgers and no subsequent Gaza heartbeat. findings.title: Injuries reported following Israeli bombardment of various areas in Gaza
findings.location: Al-Sina'a (Industry) junction, western Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Multiple civilians reportedly injured; precise number and severity unknown
findings.supporting_passage: a number of civilians suffered various injuries
findings.bounded_discovery_context: Found via direct WAFA homepage and linked report after 12 bounded searches; report published 11:51 local 9 November (01:51 PST), following predecessor heartbeat at 23:58 PST 8 November. Medical sources are cited but not named; casualty number and independent verification unavailable. Same report says a residential roof was struck in Al-Rimal and demolition operations occurred in Rafah; neither is counted as an additional casualty incident without documented harm.

findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report: Heavy Rains in the Gaza Strip | 8 November 2026 — shelter assessment
findings.affected_population_or_system: More than 26,000 households appealed for storm-related shelter/belonging damage support; approximately 600 households re-displaced; over 6,000 family shelters reportedly destroyed and 17,400 damaged; over 3,900 households reportedly without shelters; preliminary sector estimates
findings.supporting_passage: over 6,000 family shelters have reportedly been destroyed
findings.bounded_discovery_context: New official OCHA report dated 9 November found on OCHA OPT homepage during official-first check. Provides detailed numerical humanitarian assessment beyond previous storm coverage; not counted as a second separate storm or new independent displacement incident. Estimates refer to 6–8 November; exact report release hour not shown, so new-to-watch status is based on a newly issued report rather than a known event time.

findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report: Heavy Rains in the Gaza Strip | 8 November 2026 — healthcare service impacts
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex; Patient's Friends Benevolent Society Hospital; An Nakheel and Al Yasmin clinics; At Tuffah and Bir 19 medical points; Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Healthcare service capacity and access: flooding affected hospital departments, a pediatric department/pharmacy/radiology basement, two clinics and two medical points; one partner reported suspended fixed and mobile sexual/reproductive health services, others temporarily suspended mobile services; Médecins du Monde reported 54% fewer consultations during flooding
findings.supporting_passage: Health facilities also suffered leaks and flooding.
findings.bounded_discovery_context: Separately qualifying healthcare service-impact class described in the newly issued OCHA report. Some clinic and mobile team services resumed; this record describes storm-period disruption, not an assertion that all facilities remain closed on 9 November. Exact start/end times for individual disruptions unverified.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall, not authoritative production collection or publication.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: OCHA OPT and WHO checked first, then exactly 12 additional targeted searches and direct official/publisher checks. Three qualifying new-to-watch records: one newly reported civilian injury incident and two substantive OCHA storm-response follow-ups (shelter scale, medical operations). Previous report of the fatal Deir al-Balah collapse not recounted. WHO EMRO 502 and UNRWA 403 are recurrent access issues; enough authoritative alternate coverage to proceed DEGRADED/findings, not FAILED. Earlier storm impacts are not presented as new events on 9 November.
